subject: Request: Admin activity extract & SIG evidence — scope and delivery
messages:
From: Alice Park <alice.park@acmehealth.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com, security@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 02 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Admin activity extract & SIG evidence — scope and delivery

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our SIG review and upcoming SOC 2 audit, we need an extract of Redwood’s admin activity for our tenant (acmehealth-prod) covering the last 12 months. Our security team also asked for completed SIG/CAIQ control evidence where relevant to admin logging.

Can you confirm the following:
- Which admin events are captured (role changes, console logins, API key operations, delegated actions, deleted objects)?
- Retention window and whether we can request a longer slice for legally required extended retention for select accounts
- Export delivery options (S3 presigned PUT, encrypted HTTPS bundle, or direct SFTP) and expected delivery timeline
- Any PII/PHI redaction steps and attestations you will provide

We’d like a short manifest and checksums for the bundle and would prefer S3 delivery if possible. Please include an estimate for time-to-deliver and any approvals needed.

Best,
Alice
Alice Park
Security Program Manager, Acme Health

Attachment: request_summary.txt (plain text, 2 KB)
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 02 Sep 2026 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Admin activity extract & SIG evidence — scope and delivery

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear ask and the heads-up about the audit. Short answers up-front, followed by a proposed plan:

Quick summary:
- We capture admin actions: user/role creation & updates, console sign-ins and API token operations, privilege escalation events, service account key rotations, and operator-initiated data restores.
- Default retention for admin activity is 365 days; we can produce custom timebox extracts beyond that when a contract or data request justifies longer retention.
- Delivery: S3 presigned PUT (recommended), encrypted tar.gz over HTTPS, or SFTP (enterprise only).
- PII/PHI: we can apply field-level redaction on identifiers and provide a redaction report. We do not modify event timestamps or action types.

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm the exact time range (you requested 12 months — please confirm start/end).
2) Choose delivery method and provide a destination S3 bucket + write role OR request us to host a secure download link.
3) We’ll prepare a manifest (CSV) listing files, record counts, SHA256 checksums, and a small control spreadsheet linking SIG/CAIQ question ids to evidence artifacts.
4) Neha (cc’d) will scope the export and provide a delivery ETA and sample manifest by tomorrow EOD.

If you prefer, we can also provide a sampled subset (first 30 days + last 30 days + 1-in-100 sampling) for an initial review.

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Account Lead — Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>

Cc: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 03 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Admin activity extract & SIG evidence — scope and delivery

Hi Alice — following up with the technical scope and delivery plan. Aisha asked me to produce the manifest and export options; below is a concise technical playbook and the files we’ll attach for your review.

What will be included (admin activity extract):
- Event categories: ADMIN_USER_MANAGEMENT, CONSOLE_LOGIN, API_KEY_OP, ROLE_ASSIGNMENT, PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION, OPERATOR_JOB (e.g., data restore), SERVICE_ACCOUNT_ROTATE, IAM_POLICY_CHANGE.
- Fields per event: event_id, tenant_id, timestamp_utc, actor_user_id (pseudonymized if requested), actor_email (redacted optionally), event_type, target_resource_type, target_resource_id (redacted optionally), action_detail, request_ip, user_agent, request_id, retention_flag.
- Approximate size for 12-month export (acmehealth-prod): 6.8 GB compressed; 48M events.

Retention and extended slices:
- Default retained: 365 days.
- Extended retention slices: we can produce historical exports beyond 365 days on request; longer slices require a written justification and likely a one-time data retrieval fee. Specify the exact legal/contractual window and we’ll scope.

Delivery options & security:
1) S3 presigned PUT: preferred for large exports. Provide bucket name + write-only role; we’ll PUT encrypted bundles and upload manifest.csv.
2) Encrypted HTTPS bundle: AES-256-GCM encrypted tar.gz hosted on a presigned URL, 7-day expiration.
3) SFTP: enterprise only (managed onboarding).

Redaction & attestation:
- We can run field-level redaction per your guidance (hashing or removal) for actor_email and target_resource_id.
- Redaction report: includes line counts removed, redaction method, and sample before/after for 10 events.
- Chain-of-custody: SHA256 checksums per file, overall manifest signature (attached), and a PGP-encrypted checksum file on delivery.

Sampling option:
- If you want to review before full delivery: we’ll deliver a 2% random sample + full manifest for parity checks.

Attachments we will include in the initial handoff (stubs attached to this thread):
- admin_activity_manifest.csv (manifest columns: filename,event_count,sha256,compressed_size_bytes,timestamp_utc)
- sig_question_responses_v1.pdf (maps SIG control IDs to artifacts and export locations)

ETA and approvals:
- ETA for full 12-month export once delivery method and access are confirmed: 3 business days.
- If extended retention requested, add 2–5 business days depending on scope.
- No legal signatures required for the standard export; extended retention for >24 months requires procurement approval and an export request ticket.

Sample manifest header (first line):
filename,event_count,sha256,compressed_size_bytes,timestamp_utc
admin_activity_20250901-20260901_part1.csv.gz,12000000,3a7f...b21c,2350000000,2026-09-03T08:30:00Z

Operational notes for Acme security team:
- We will not alter event timestamps or event_type labels.
- If you require cryptographic attestation, we can provide an HMAC of the manifest signed with our rotation-protected key.

Next actions for Acme: provide preferred delivery method and destination, and confirm whether actor_email and target_resource_id should be redacted. If you choose S3, include a temporary write-only role or pre-signed PUT details.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment placeholders: admin_activity_manifest.csv (CSV), sig_question_responses_v1.pdf (PDF)
